definitions.explanation: A word that has the opposite meaning of another word. A fundamental concept in linguistics and language education, used when discussing vocabulary relationships.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧」⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{反意語|はんいご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧」だ。
{反意語|はんいご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}り→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
examples.english: Make a sentence using an antonym.

examples.japanese: ⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{反意語|はんいご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{語彙|ごい}→語彙：14214_goi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効率|こうりつ}→効率：11794_kouritsu⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Memorizing kanji antonym pairs is an efficient way to build vocabulary.

notes:
Compound of {反意|はんい} ('opposite meaning') and ⟦{語|ご}→〜語：09841_go⟧ ('word'). The standard linguistic term for words with opposite meanings, frequently encountered in language textbooks, dictionaries, and vocabulary study materials.

USAGE:
- Commonly encountered in Japanese language classes and textbooks when studying vocabulary relationships.
- In Japanese, many antonym pairs are formed by kanji with opposing meanings: ⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧/⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧, ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧/⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧, {入|い}る/⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧.
- The variant ⟦{反対語|はんたいご}→反対語：29409_hantaigo⟧ is used interchangeably in everyday contexts and is slightly more colloquial.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {反意語|はんいご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧: to look up an antonym
- {反意語|はんいご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: antonymic relationship
- {反意語|はんいご}⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧: antonym dictionary

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{反対語|はんたいご}→反対語：29409_hantaigo⟧: antonym — near-synonym; slightly more colloquial variant using ⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧ ('opposite') instead of {反意|はんい}
- ⟦{対義語|たいぎご}→対義語：29399_taigigo⟧: antonym — the most formal and technically precise term, preferred in academic linguistics
- ⟦{類義語|るいぎご}→類義語：15939_ruigigo⟧: synonym — word with a similar meaning; the opposite concept
- ⟦{同義語|どうぎご}→同義語：26263_dougigo⟧: synonym — word with the same meaning; even closer equivalence than ⟦{類義語|るいぎご}→類義語：15939_ruigigo⟧
